steps: Visit the official portal and click on Register.
Choose either Jan Aadhaar or Google to process registration and complete it.
Log in to the dashboard and click on RAJ-KISAN.
Click on Application Entry Request under Citizen.
Enter the Bhamashah Family ID, select the person and scheme name, complete Aadhaar authentication, and provide details.
parsed.department: Agriculture Department of the Rajasthan government
